entity.summary: British Virgin Islands-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in October 2019 and providing current spot, futures, earn, launchpad, and payment-related services.
entity.notes: Current first-party About material identifies BICONOMY PTE. LTD, gives a Road Town, Tortola address in the British Virgin Islands, and describes a global cryptocurrency exchange platform. The current first-party site exposes spot, futures, earn, launchpad, payment, API, and mobile-app services. Current independent exchange data reports recently updated markets, substantial non-zero volume, reserves, a 2019 establishment year, and British Virgin Islands registration. CoinGecko states October 2019 but not an exact day, so October 1 is used as a month-level marker. This exchange is distinct from the Biconomy Web3 infrastructure protocol and BICO token project.
